requirements.quote: *   A gzip-compressed tar archive named `scripts_backup.tar.gz` must exist inside the `/home/user/archives` directory.
*   Paths inside the archive must be stored relative to the `scripts` directory, meaning they must begin with `./`.
*   The archive must contain the complete content of `/home/user/provisioning/scripts`, with its internal directory structure preserved.

check.cmd: for f in deploy.sh teardown.sh utils/common.sh README.md; do tar -tzf /home/user/archives/scripts_backup.tar.gz | grep -qx "./$f" || exit 1; done

requirements.quote: *   Extract it and confirm that it contains exactly those four paths and nothing else.
One more thing: `/var/spool/reef` is no longer wanted on this host, so remove it and all of its contents.
